_notes.tealUsage: Teal is a precise accent, not a default fill. Use for: primary CTA, active/selected state, status indicators, key numerals. Do not apply to every icon, link, or as a background fill.
_notes.tealDeepUsage: Use for large headline text on light backgrounds and link text that needs readable contrast against paper, where the bright teal would be too low-contrast.
_notes.borderRadius: 0 throughout — square corners on all containers, cards, and buttons. This is a deliberate brand choice, not an oversight.
_notes.spacing: Err toward generous padding. Marketing site uses 130px section padding; app screens can compress to 64-96px for primary content but should not go denser than that.
